# Tobias Schnorpfeil

> Engineer and entrepreneur based in Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany. Shareholder (3rd generation) at Heinz Schnorpfeil Bau GmbH, where he works on management, digitalization, tech and innovation. Co-founder of the travel-tech startup Mapify, which was acquired by HomeToGo. B.Sc. Civil Engineering, Technical University of Munich.

## Summary

- **Current Role:** Heinz Schnorpfeil Bau GmbH — Shareholder (3rd generation), leading digitalization, technology and innovation across the group. Previously 4 years as site construction manager (Bauleiter) in road and bridge infrastructure.
- **Previous Startup:** Mapify (Co-Founder, 2017–2023) — Travel-tech platform with 250k+ users in 190+ countries, backed by Lakestar Ventures & Atlantic Labs, acquired by HomeToGo.
- **Education:** B.Sc. Civil Engineering, Technical University of Munich (TUM, 2016).
- **Creative Background:** Director, photographer and 3D artist (2014–2021) for Porsche, Adidas, Jack Wolfskin, Munich Tourism.
